lines.en: I make my way over to the bar (The regular one, not the second bar that I secretly visit on Fridays now) and find that, for some reason, Kaori is working here again.
I’m not sure why, considering that today is, at least to my knowledge, not a special occasion or holiday.  But I’m also not about to put any amount of thought into why Kaori does...well, anything.
Instead, I’ll just focus on the small girl beside her.
: Welcome once again, Friendburger! The special dizzy drink of the day is-
: Hey, Sana. Working alone again tonight?
: So far...not really...
: Kaori keeps helping the customers before I...even have a chance to...
: Kaori? Is she here right now?
: Do not give into the foul temptations of your sight balls’ endless longing for the dark! The Queen of Spiders stands before you! In the same place as always!
: Always? You’ve worked here like three times.
: So you can see.
: That was not a very funny human joke, Friend. Invisibility is a terrifying sickness that comes to claim us all one day. I was worried my time may have expired for a sixtieth of a minute.
: That...would be called a “second...”
: Thank you, Sana- for taking up my role as Kaori’s unofficial human tutor. It feels like just yesterday that I was coming here to teach you how to be human.
: Is that...why you were coming here? It wasn’t...to teach me how to be more...umm...confident when it comes to...speaking?
: If you want my human opinion, I think your speaking is nice. Your voice reminds me of glass and the color periwinkle.
: Confidence...humanity...they’re kind of interchangeable at this point, I think. That’s why it’s okay for people like Kaori to breathe the same air as us.
: She never makes any sense, but her confidence in the act of making no sense helps her blend in pretty well.
: On the other end of the spectrum, you have zero confidence, but are also one of the most unremarkable and exceedingly average human beings I have ever encountered.
: You don’t have to blend in at all since you’re already a part of the background.
: So I guess that, in a sense, my job here is done. You’re as human as you’ll ever be.
: Un...remarkable?...
: Exceedingly...average?...
: Are you...calling me...boring?...
: Yes.
: W...Why?! Did you come here just to...hurt me?!
: Hey, being boring isn’t bad. I like being with you because it’s relaxing and I never have to worry about you drugging me or threatening to tie me up and do things to my body.
: Who are you spending your time with that makes you worry about those things?!
: Pretty much everyone. Which is why I like you. It’s a nice change of pace.
: This is the strangest...compliment I’ve ever received...
: And you say that I am bad at human conversation, Friend. Can you not see that you are making the tiny human uncomfortable?
: I’m not...uncomfortable...I...
: I think I am...offended...
: Offended?
: Y...Yes.
: You made me mad...and...
: And for that...you will pay.
: Hah...I tried...being intimidating to...change things up, but...I...just sounded stupid...didn’t I?
: You did not sound like yourself. The mini Sara spawn that I know of is never intimidating. Like a tiny gerbil but with marshmallows for teeth and only one eyeball.
: I’ll just accept that...my test of “humanity” is finally complete and...that Sensei has no use for me anymore...
: To be completely honest, though...you have improved a lot. In terms of speaking, I mean. Which I will now clarify as the actual purpose of all of these visits.
: And in a sense...I think your test is complete. But that doesn’t mean I don’t have any more use for you.
: C...Complete?...
: But I still...
: Keep...pausing...in the middle of...sentences...
: Yeah, but I think that just might be how you talk. When you look at the amount you’ve accomplished since we’ve met one another, it’s a lot more than most.
: You’ve made a bunch of friends...you can stand next to Kaori without getting scared...Hell, you’ve even joined the light music club.
: That’s a lot, Sana. I’m really proud of-
: Light music club?!
: Since when are you in the light music club?! Since when are you in any club at all?! Why didn’t you tell me?!
: I didn’t tell you b...because I knew you would...act like this...
: Like what?! Excited that my little girl is finally finding her place in the world?!
: Why have you been hiding my daughter’s character growth from me?
: Why is it up to me to relay her growth to you?
: Why are we...still talking about me?...I would like to...go back to being...unremarkable now...
: Absolutely not! You are my daughter and the world will know of your adorableness! I don’t care if I have to burn down all of Kumon-mi to show them.
: Please don’t...burn down the city for me...This summer is already...hot enough...
: Sara, I get that you like your daughter and that’s totally chill. But I ain’t afraid of kickin’ your ass if you burn down both my job and apartment. I ain’t goin’ back to the streets, you hear me?
: Shut up. If you can be proud of your daughter for putting some girl into a coma, I can be proud of my baby for becoming a rock star.
: M...Mom! I...don’t even know how to...play anything yet...
: Yet! Which means you will! And I don’t care if I have to burn down all of Kumon-mi to ensure that!
: Where did this sudden fascination with arson come from?
: From the burning love I feel for my mini Sara spawn.
: I have a name! And can we stop talking about me now?!
Sara decides to give her daughter a break and retreats to the corner of the bar with Yuki after she finishes dealing with a table full of customers.
It’s not much being just one table, but it’s more than usual for a random school night.
And if Sara can afford having four people on shift at once, I think it’s safe to say things might actually be turning around for the Sakakibaras.
With the youngest of them managing to turn things around for herself as well, I can’t help but feel something reminiscent of what normal people would call “happiness” bubbling up inside of me.
But then again, I could just be lightheaded from having so many attractive girls in matching outfits standing in close proximity to me.
You’d think the novelty of that would have worn off by now, but...nope.
: If you do not want us to talk about you, what do you suggest we speak of, mini Sara spawn?
: The lack of patrons in this establishment signals to me that this would be a good opportunity to become close to one another as I will be standing in this spot more frequently going forward.
: You will?
: The time has come for a new companion! One that I must acquire additional moneys for! And also because being around Aunt Yukiburger makes me happy!
: I’m also...going to have to spend more time with my club, so...I won’t be able to help out around here as much anymore...
: Having Kaori help is...well...it’s a lot of things...but I...think it will be for the best...
: Think you’ll be able to survive a room full of loud, energetic girls playing what I assume will be loud, energetic music?
: The music...I don’t mind...but it might be...hard fitting in with everyone at first since...they’re all so cool and I’m...umm...what was it again?...
: Unremarkable and exceedingly average?
: R...Right...
: You seem to care a lot for the mini Sara spawn, Friend. Is this what humans call love?
: Wh-What?! No! Of...Of course not!
: Then why is the temperature of your tiny human body steadily rising?
: Size has naught to do with reaching sexual maturity, mini Sara. Not when cats are primed and ready to reproduce at only four months old!
: That’s...way too young!
: Yeah, that just made me uncomfortable.
: There is no reason to feel discomfort, Friend! Intercourse creates more fluffy animals and if you want to create more animals with the Sara spawn, I think you should!
: Sana-
: No! Absolutely not! I am not...looking for a...mate!
: I was just going to ask if you loved me like Kaori suggested.
: I don’t even like you!
: Well, that’s just rude.
: That’s...not what I...
: So, uhh...animals! Right?
: Would you like to learn more about the rituals of mating and-
: Nope! Something...entirely unrelated to that!
: Baby animals?
: What is your favorite baby animal, Friend? They are all good and there are no wrong answers. So please answer correctly!
: But-
: Too slow! The correct answer is the baby sea turtle!
: Did you know that in a single nesting season, sea turtles can lay over one thousand eggs?!
: That is so much egg! Glorious egg!
: I wonder if...Koi Cafe is hiring?...
: My favorite baby animal is the lamb because all of the bad things you do in life can be forgiven by ritualistically sacrificing one.

: Without the shedding of blood, there is no forgiveness of sin. And while sacrifices at the behest of  gods run deeper than the rivers of our ancestry, our ability to accept and embrace them does not.
: A long time ago, a group of men in suits showed up at my doorstep. We took them in and fed them after wiping the blood from our hands and were swiftly rewarded with eternal life.
: That is why I can still smile today. Why I can drink and be merry. Why I can stand before you two in my purest form.
: I am eternal. All of this exists for me.
: And none of it would be possible without a pile of lifeless baby sheep and blood smeared over the door of my home to attract more visitors.
: I can’t wait to have sex with both of you at the same time.
INCORRECT RESPONSE PROVIDED.
THE EVENT WILL NOW REVERT TO ITS PREVIOUS STATE.
PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT THIS PROCESS IS STILL UNDERGOING TESTING AND THAT ADDITIONAL ABNORMALITIES MAY OCCUR.
: I wonder if...Koi Cafe is-
: I concur that the ideal baby animal is the sea turtle. Oh, glorious egg.
: You did it! You got it right! Congratulations!
: I...really don’t like when you two...speak...like that...
: Like what?
: Like...saying things that don’t really make sense...
: It makes me...a little uncomfortable...like...like something...weird is...
: Is...going on...

: There is nothing weird about the baby sea turtle, mini Sara! They are at their most adorable when they have to flip-flap flip-flap across black sandy beaches, dodging talons of predators along the way.
: In a sense, that is what we all do every day in this human life!
: We wake up and slide our fleshy motion tubes out of our soft rectangle, hoping that the giant welcome box we live in does not dissolve into the earth!
: Then, we pour ourselves a deep ceramic plate of sugar squares coated in cow juice to ward off the evil as we make our way into the world itself!
: But before we can leave, we have to stare back at ourselves!
: Thank our organs and remember to smile!
: For the moment we forget to do those things, the welcome box becomes an unwelcome box.
: And it all decays from there.
: What are you doing?
: Who, me? Oh, you know...Just being irresponsible with my money and buying Sana a drum set as an early Christmas present.
: Oh, shit.
: Here’s hoping she ain’t a piece of shit like my daughter and doesn’t toss it off a bridge.
: I doubt she’ll be strong enough to lift it. Us Sakakibaras aren’t exactly known for our strength.
: What are you known for, then? Apart from running the least popular bar in all of Kumon-mi.
: Hmm...
: Wanting to fuck our teachers?
: Dude.
: So, Sana...you’ve made new friends...joined a club...and can now (At least partially) conquer a conversation with the single most confusing person I have ever encountered.
: Would it be preemptive to label today’s meeting as a graduation and finally put an end to your training arc?
: It...doesn’t feel like much of a...graduation and...and I still have a lot of improving to do, but...
: If you think...I’ll be okay...then I’ll probably be okay...
: Congratulations, mini Sara. Most people do not make it to the amount of words I was able to say to you. They always run away.
: I will reward you by writing your name in my special notebook of friends. And, if you do not count animals, you are one of the first ten entries!
: Uhh...thanks...but I...I don’t really...need a reward for...existing...
: How about a drink then?
: Why do all of the adults I know always encourage me to drink?...
: I will not allow the mini Sara to consume the dizzy drinks on my watch.
: She may have reached the age of sexual maturity, but is still far too young to partake in an activity as hellacious as the consumption of alcohol!
: You may reward her with a child instead.
: I...think I’m going to refuse...both of those things...
: I...talk too much when I drink and...and I want to start...talking...without that...
: Then...I guess it’ll just be an entirely unceremonious graduation and we’ll all go on with our lives in the exact same fashion we’ve been going about them thus far.
: By dodging the talons of predators!
: Dodging the talons of predators...
The three of us make a toast, but I am the only one who drinks.
That is, until Sara and Yuki rejoin me and the rest of the night goes by with us constantly asking Kaori for refills.
Sana goes home somewhere around my third or fourth beer, but I don’t see her leave.
Around my sixth, I begin to wonder if it has anything to do with the fact that she’s already accustomed to never saying goodbye to those she cares about.
Around my ninth, I think of a lamb.
Though, I’m not quite sure why.
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
